picnic.en: A picnic by the lake is the best part of spring.
picnic.cn: 湖边野餐是春天最棒的事。

basket.en: Mum filled the basket with sandwiches and fruit.
basket.cn: 妈妈把篮子装满了三明治和水果。

sandwich.en: I made cheese sandwiches for our picnic.
sandwich.cn: 我做了奶酪三明治带去野餐。

juice.en: Fresh orange juice tastes much better than soda.
juice.cn: 鲜橙汁比汽水好喝多了。

lake.en: We can see many ducks swimming on the lake.
lake.cn: 我们能看到湖上有很多鸭子在游。

sunny.en: On a sunny Saturday, our family always goes for a walk.
sunny.cn: 阳光明媚的周六，我们家总会出去散步。

share.en: We share our food and stories at the picnic.
share.cn: 我们在野餐时分享食物和故事。

enjoy.en: I really enjoy spending time with friends in nature.
enjoy.cn: 我很享受和朋友在大自然里的时光。
